_README: Declarative inbound-link registry for reachsocial.co. Cross-linking used to be a
periodic backfill (see ClickUp 86bc9bp1f): a new page shipped, nothing linked to
it, and someone ran a cleanup days later. Both of the newest pages were the only
two un-indexed URLs on the site as a direct result.
Every inbound link is declared HERE, once, and applied by crosslink.py. Two
reasons that matters:
1. It is a PUBLISH step. crosslink.py --verify exits non-zero when a declared
link is missing, so shipping an orphan is a hard failure, not an omission.
2. It SURVIVES A RE-RENDER. Case-study HTML is generated by the case-study-reach
skill from a ClickUp task, so a hand edit to casestudies/<slug>/index.html is
destroyed the next time that task is rendered. A declaration is not.
Each entry answers: which page should link TO my target, and with what sentence.
target : the page that should RECEIVE the link (for the log, and for --verify)
file   : the file to edit. For BLOG posts always target the generator SOURCE
(blog/_generator/posts/<slug>.body.html), never the rendered output,
or render_post.py will overwrite it.
anchor : text of a heading inside the section to append to. The block is
inserted just before that section's closing tag.

html : the paragraph to insert. One

. Reach voice, em-dashes allowed.
crosslink.py wraps each block in sentinel comments, so re-applying replaces
rather than duplicating, and --verify can tell a real link from prose that
happens to mention the URL.
